description:
Goal

Make every EntryCapture transport position name the same original lowered entry that ExecutableFacts and RuntimeDemand use, even after MaterializedExecutable prunes and compacts backend entries.

Signal

In 00420_enum_take_drop_split, compact backend entry 1 is original entry 4. required_call_edge_transport_positions currently emits EntryCapture(entry=1, capture_index=1) from the pruned body. TransportShape interprets that key against unpruned ExecutableFacts entry 1, selecting v5/:cont with Ignore instead of original entry 4 capture v1:int with Whole. The backend therefore constructs Absent where reduce_while_cont requires ValueRef. The retired unmatched-callable Whole fallback concealed this namespace error.

Strategy

Move the identity correction upstream: transport-position construction over a materialized/pruned executable must translate compact entry IDs through MaterializedExecutable.original_entry_ids before publishing EntryCapture keys. Keep original-entry identity explicit and typed; do not use Ty display strings, semantic equivalence, or conservative Whole widening. Audit all EntryCapture producers and consumers so the key has one meaning.

TDD and acceptance

- First add a focused RED regression with at least two original entries where pruning compacts a later entry onto an earlier numeric ID and the two same-index captures have different demands/layouts.
- Prove the emitted call-edge EntryCapture key uses the original entry ID and TransportShape selects the later entry's exact capture demand.
- Prove unaffected entry/capture keys retain their identity and layout.
- 00420_enum_take_drop_split passes through interpreter, run, and build doors with no Absent/ValueRef mismatch.
- Existing transport-contract, runtime-demand, fixture, determinism, formatting, clippy, and warning-denied gates pass.
- No unmatched-callable Whole fallback, canonical Ty string comparison, compatibility shim, or duplicate entry-identity authority is introduced.
- Update agent/user documentation only if the observable identity contract was previously misstated.

Removal

Remove temporary diagnostics and any obsolete compact-entry assumptions exposed by the correction. The final representation has one EntryCapture entry namespace: original lowered entry IDs.
title: Preserve original entry identity in entry-capture transport keys
